name: zaidsaid-liquid-glass
description: iOS-26 liquid-glass beat plugins for the zaidsaid HyperFrames renderer. Mirrors the pipeline shown in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Aw3BkmhYu4I.

items.name: liquid-glass-card
items.title: Liquid-glass beat card
items.description: A 480×600 frosted-glass beat card with eyebrow, chrome-gradient title, and an optional karaoke caption run. Drop into a host composition via data-composition-src for one beat scene.

items.name: outro-split
items.title: Split-screen outro
items.description: A 1080×1920 outro scene: dimmed gradient backdrop, face-cam crop on the right with rounded corners + drop shadow, headline text on the left.

items.name: karaoke-caption
items.title: Karaoke caption run
items.description: Word-by-word highlight effect — each .word span flips from dim to lit with a 22 px glow when its data-word-start fires on the host timeline. Paste CSS + script into a host composition.

items.name: chrome-text
items.title: Chrome gradient text
items.description: Silver-to-white gradient applied via background-clip:text. Use on titles and eyebrows for the iOS-26 look. Paste the .chrome-title / .chrome-eyebrow rules into your styles.
